description.value: Trail Bicycles is a full-service bike shop in Courtenay serving the Comox Valley, carrying premium brands including Trek, Norco, Mondraker, Ibis, Pivot, and Salsa. They hold Shimano Service Centre certification, meaning mechanics are trained to the latest standards using genuine Shimano parts. Visiting cyclists can also rent full-suspension mountain bikes with helmets and get insider knowledge on local trails including the renowned Cumberland network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Trail Bicycles is an active full-service bike shop at 1170 Cliffe Ave, Courtenay, BC, matching OSM address and phone. The service page states 'We're ready to answer your questions, assess and service your bike - or just fix a flat. Any type of bike is welcome at Trail' and they hold Shimano Service Centre certification, confirming mechanic availability. Bike rentals are explicitly offered on a dedicated rentals page, and the extensive e-bike sales section plus Shimano certification supports e-bike servicing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service bike shop with certified mechanics, walk-in repair service, bike rentals, and e-bike servicing in a major BC cycling destination — a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website address includes full postal code V9N 2K1, which is absent from the OSM record. OSM community field shows 'Unknown' but business is clearly in Courtenay/Comox Valley.

Staff help with urgent mechanical issues.detail: You don't need an appointment for the first consult; just visit us at the shop and bring your bike with you.

E-bike service.detail: Shimano Service Centre certification and active e-bike sales (Norco, Mondraker, Trek Fuel+); service page states 'Any type of bike is welcome at Trail.'

Bike rentals.detail: Dedicated rentals page confirms 'premium performance and well-maintained full suspension mountain bikes ready for you to rent'; fleet includes Trek Fuel EX and Trek Fuel+ EX; rentals include helmet and basic repair kit
